🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Oil tops $100, but no gasolinazo in Mexico</u>

Brent crude has pushed past $100 a barrel as the US-Israel-Iran war drags on, dragging Pemex's export mix to $100.04. At Mexican pumps, nothing moves: Sheinbaum's government is holding regular gasoline at 24 pesos a liter and diesel below 27, absorbing the IEPS excise week by week so the global oil shock never reaches the driver.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum to Washington: Mexico is nobody's piñata</u>

President Sheinbaum to Washington: Mexico is 'nobody's piñata.' Responding to Secretary Rubio, she said the US uses Mexico 'as an argument in its campaigns' while ignoring the record — 67,000+ arrests and 34,000+ weapons seized, 80% of them from the United States. 'We cooperate, but we do not subordinate ourselves. Let it be heard, loud and clear: we are a free, independent, sovereign country.'

🇲🇽🌎 Two centuries of foreign intervention — and Mexico still decides its own destiny. "Mexico decides its destiny without the help of any foreign intervention. A people with no memory has no compass: if we don't recall where we came from, we don't know where we're going." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 11 From the Pastry War to the U.S. war of conquest that took half the territory, to Ambassador Wilson's hand in the 1914 coup against Madero — she traced every intervention, and every defense of sovereignty, in Mexico's independence month.

🇲🇽✊ Accountability in Chiapas: 70,500 homes, 1,300 clinics, and the Interoceanic Corridor at 94%. Before some 70,000 people at the Víctor Manuel Reyna stadium in Tuxtla Gutiérrez, President Sheinbaum delivered her second-year report for Chiapas. Announcements: 70,500 homes for families earning under two minimum wages; 1,300 clinics adapted under "La Clínica es Nuestra," opening January 2027; the Interoceanic Corridor now 94% complete and reaching Ciudad Hidalgo on the Guatemala border; a Tren Maya cargo line; new hospitals in Palenque, San Cristóbal and Tuxtla; and 79 Centros Libres para Mujeres. Por Esto!

🚨🇲🇽 Trump's ICE tripled arrests; some 350,000 deported in 2026, with billions in fines imposed on migrants. Reporting compiled through early September documents 70,000+ migrants detained and just over 350,000 deported in 2026. From Trump's return in January 2025 through mid-July 2026, ICE issued 103,000+ civil fines reported to total more than US$84 billion — and is now pursuing deported migrants across Mexico and Central America to collect. Tripled arrests, abuses and deaths in custody are documented alongside. SinEmbargo

🇲🇽🏭 Plan México accelerates: national content, well-paid jobs, and value chains built at home. The government is speeding up its National Industrialization and Shared Prosperity Strategy, tied to the 2027 economic package. Its six pillars: more national and regional content in strategic sectors; well-paid manufacturing and innovation jobs; greater local value-added in supply chains; "polos de bienestar" and industrial corridors; clear investment priorities; and continental regional integration — a bet on producing more of what Mexico consumes. Mexico News Daily

🇲🇽🌎 Sheinbaum draws the red line in the tariff talks with Washington: sovereignty. "We will not sign anything that affects our sovereignty and our economy." Ahead of talks with U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, President Sheinbaum said Mexico's limit in the T-MEC and tariff negotiations is what it considers non-negotiable. Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard called the meeting "cordial" and traveled to Washington to continue; Mexico is pressing to cut U.S. tariffs on steel, aluminum and autos. No deal yet. Infobae

🇲🇽🏭 Record jobs and the OECD's lowest unemployment after Japan — under U.S. tariffs. "Our adversaries insist the Mexican economy is doing badly — but no. Every indicator shows we're doing well... we're the country with the fewest tariffs in the world. But we're doing well." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Sept 11 The IMSS posted a record 22,798,473 formal jobs in August; the OECD again ranked Mexico's unemployment the lowest after Japan — even amid the new U.S. tariff policy.
